summary.name: ResumePlot AI
summary.one_liner: ResumePlot AI is a browser-based resume builder that helps you import or write a resume, strengthen bullet points with optional AI suggestions, tailor it to a job description, and export an ATS-friendly PDF or JSON file.
use_cases: Rewriting vague resume bullets into measurable achievements
Tailoring a resume to a specific job description
Creating an ATS-friendly resume from scratch or an imported file
Exporting a searchable PDF for job applications
Keeping an editable JSON copy of a resume for other roles
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a resume editor where you can import a PDF, DOCX or text file, or start from a guided template. Each bullet can be strengthened with AI suggestions, which are only applied after you review them. You can match the resume against a job description to surface relevant experience. Output can be exported as a searchable PDF or saved as JSON, and the resume can be kept for editing for other roles. Editing and importing run in the browser, while AI requests, cloud saves and sharing send the relevant content to the service.
notable: Local-first editing: importing and editing stay in the browser
Optional AI suggestions that are never applied without user review
Exports searchable, ATS-friendly PDF and editable JSON
Professional templates editable in English or Chinese
caveats: AI requests, cloud saves and sharing send resume content to the service
Free plan has limits and sign-in is required (per the directory listing)
Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page
